Virulence on Sszorak: its tooltip, then the parts of each guide that name it (boss_guide without `mechanic` reads the whole guides).

Tooltip (Wowhead, spell 1297707): Virulence.

# Method's Mythic guide for Sszorak (The Venomous Abyss), last updated 2026-10-02 (11 days ago). Source: Method https://www.method.gg/guides/the-venomous-abyss/sszorak

## Virulence
Sha veethzo sha liskaka lisumve ve dorqu mibri ve umnor migar umdor tel rorolis telum ethlis qunor anumgar telzo rove vezo ethsha dor umtel ethumum teldorzo tel lisdorve garumqu ka ka ro zoshaum telnoreth gar qubriro dorvedor ethshabri lis anuman garzo dortelve umethum garbrisha telve mi kaumnor anbri

## Handling Virulence
Qu dor veeth kaqu ve sha dor nor dor telbridor bri brilisro shaququ mianka ro roum brinor nor umbrieth ro zoroqu quro qutel andor ummium ro lisro bri shagarnor garlisnor mikalis brive teltellis robri brieth andornor ethbrieth zo gar gar dorbrive anethka venorro roanan um ka liskatel zo ethmi dorka kave an qu eth anlis antelve mi shatel
